text:
Anna P.: heads-up — preparing to ship private/vpc onprem installer v1.12.3 today in the 17:00-18:00 UTC change window. this is the delta installer (delta-on-disk) + signed artifact bundle. key items: cosign signer rotation (new key expires 2026-04-02), transport manifest epoch bump, and a small courier-only canary (customer-a, customer-b).

Kevin O.: do we have the transport method locked? last time customer-a wanted sftp courier, customer-b used airgap USB. need to confirm so packaging can produce the right payloads.

DeployBot: packaging-build #pkg-20260320-7 triggered by @Anna P.
- artifact: s3://redwood-private/installs/v1.12.3/delta-installer.tar.gz
- manifest: s3://redwood-private/installs/v1.12.3/manifest-epoch-20260320.json
- cosign: cosign.sig (key-id: julia-rot-2026)

Julia S.: cosign key was rotated yesterday. I re-signed the bundle with julia-rot-2026 and mirrored the public key to the KMS-backed signer endpoint. BUT note: some carriers still have the older key pinned, so we need handshake step on delivery.

Anna P.: understood. plan: 1) courier (SFTP) for customer-a, 2) sealed USB for customer-b (ops will handle physical handoff), 3) offsite mirror for backup. we'll include both public key files in the manifest and a small handshake script for carriers.

Marco S.: checklist:
- Verify sha256 checksum in staging
- Confirm manifest epoch in deploybot matches carrier manifest
- Run cosign verify against both keys on recipient VM
- Monitor canary metrics (startup errors, http 5xx, license check failures)

Sarah R.: adding rollback triggers: if canary >5% failures in first 10 minutes OR cosign verify fails on delivery -> abort and retract manifest pin (roll back to v1.12.2 manifest-epoch). who owns retract?

Kevin O.: ops will retract; I can run the revoke/pinback sequence. need the exact commands in the playbook though.

Anna P.: placing the playbook snippet here for ops. please copy into runbook before window:
```bash
# verify artifact locally
sha256sum delta-installer.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}' > expected.sha256
# verify cosign signature (both keys)
cosign verify -key julia-rot-2026.pub delta-installer.tar.gz
cosign verify -key julia-old-2025.pub delta-installer.tar.gz || true
# rollback (re-pin manifest)
redwoodctl manifest pin --namespace=customer-a --manifest=manifest-epoch-20260319.json
# emergency revoke
redwoodctl packaging revoke --artifact=delta-installer.tar.gz --reason="canary failures"
```

Julia S.: small note — `cosign verify` will fail if the recipient's cosign binary is older and doesn't support the new key algorithm. I've added a compatibility header in the manifest that points to the compatibility shim. include that in the courier payload.

Marco S.: sending a small health probe agent with the package (python one-liner) to report startup success back to our canary endpoint.
```py
import requests
requests.post('https://canary.redwoodops.io/hook', json={'id':'customer-a','status':'ok'})
```

DeployBot: canary deploy started for customer-a at 1719505655. canary window: 10m. artifact pkg-20260320-7 -> canary slot #3.

Sarah R.: I'll watch the canary dashboard. Anna, assign someone to call immediate rollback if metrics cross thresholds.

Anna P.: Marco you own the first response; Kevin you own manifest unpin/revoke. Julia on signer troubleshooting. Sarah monitoring. I'm on standby for communications.

Kevin O.: ack. I'll be ready to run `redwoodctl manifest pin` if needed. have the credentials and the keyring open. :thumbsup:

Marco S.: :eyes: will watch logs and canary hook. I'll post any anomalies here.

DeployBot: canary report (10m) — customer-a: startup success 98.7%, 5xx rate 0.8% (within threshold). cosign verify both keys: OK.

Anna P.: sweet. schedule full rollout at 17:30 UTC if no regressions. team, final call: any objections to rolling manifest pin at 17:30?

Julia S.: no objections. leave the compatibility shim in the payload for the next 2 releases.

Kevin O.: good from ops. ensure USB handoff for customer-b is timestamped and signed chain-of-custody.

Sarah R.: i'll keep a 30m post-rollout watch. set a 60m quick follow to confirm no dormant issues.

Anna P.: thanks all. will post release notes and the `manifest-epoch-20260320.json` link once full rollout is live. :partyparrot:
